The '''Kilandran Royal Forces''' was a military order that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[700 BBY]], it merged with a number of other military orders, to form the [[Iotran Police Force]], a military force that was based on [[Iotra]]. Following the merger, the Royal Forces continued to exist within the Police Force, as an organizational unit.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'' establishes the name of the organization as the "Kinlandrin Royal Forces." The later source, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', spells the group's name as the '''Kilandran Royal Forces'''. This article assumes that ''Privates & Privateers'' is correct as the more recently published source.
